alt: Two pages of the Studio+91 2025 calendar lying on a wooden table: on top, August, with a watercolour of women in yellow and gold dancing, Independence Day and Ganesh Chaturthi marked; beneath it, the edge of June.
caption: Two pages of a 2025 calendar, one showing August with a watercolor illustration of dancers, resting on a wooden surface.
description: Two open pages of a 2025 calendar lie on a light wood table. The top page shows the month of August next to a colorful watercolor illustration of figures in flowing clothing. The page underneath is partially visible, showing the beginning of the June section. Small red text marks holidays on the dates.
